data_freshness_policy.mechanism: Every rule in this domain carries a review_by date at domain level. When it has passed, the engine must append a verification note to any advisory drawing on this domain rather than presenting the figure as current.

trigger_dsl.unknown_rule: A rule whose trigger evaluates UNKNOWN must NOT fire and must NOT be treated as FALSE. Report reduced confidence and name the missing field (Domain 12 D12-COLD-001).

notification_policy.why: The season simulation issued 998 messages across 301 days before this existed. A trigger expresses a condition and a condition stays true; the advice is an event and must be delivered once.

classes.ONCE_UNTIL_RESOLVED: Standing precondition. Once, then a 7/21/45/90 day ladder with rising severity.
classes.EVENT: Transient physical event. Rising edge only; re-armed after it clears.
classes.WINDOW: Dated operation. Advance warning, the day, then 3 overdue reminders.
classes.SILENT_GUARD: Prevention rule. No message unless the prohibited action is attempted.

notification_policy.result: 998 messages became 43 in the normal season, with no critical stage left silent for more than 15 days.

override_policy.why: The Tier-1 review worked but was offline. An agronomist looking at a live plot in August cannot edit JSON and wait for a deploy; by then the window has closed.
override_policy.scope_precedence: narrowest wins — plot over cluster over global
override_policy.expiry_rationale: A permanent change belongs in the knowledge base, not in the override table.
override_policy.immutable_rationale: Some rules exist because getting them wrong causes harm no agronomic judgement outweighs. The API refuses them by code path, and a database trigger refuses them again if the application layer is bypassed.
override_policy.audit: Refused attempts are recorded, not discarded. An attempt to override an immutable rule is a governance signal.

metadata.validation_note: Scheme rates and eligibility are from published scheme pages and are subject to annual government resolution. Every figure must be confirmed with the Taluka Agriculture Officer before an application is made. Several institutional facts are inferences rather than confirmations and are marked accordingly.
metadata.rule_count_note: 32 is the number of distinct, traceable rules the source document supports. No rules were generated to reach a target count.
metadata.review_note: This is the only domain with expiring content. Subsidy rates change by annual GR, contacts change with postings, and CIB&RC listings are revised. Half of this file will be out of date within a year.
metadata.purpose: The institutional layer — what exists, what is available, and who to ask. Domains 1 to 9 establish what the crop needs; this domain establishes whether the local system can supply it and at what cost.
key_innovations: The three things Domains 3, 7 and 8 declared preconditions — drip, water storage and shade — each have a dedicated state subsidy scheme, and Kannad sits in the priority region for all three. That is not coincidence; the schemes exist precisely for drought-prone areas like this one.

A farm pond solves two problems at once. Monsoon water must be removed from the root zone to prevent soft rot, and the same water is short four months later. Storage converts a disposal problem into a supply solution.

The subsidy chain includes a lottery and takes months, so it begins six or more months before planting rather than alongside land preparation. And work started before pre-sanction is not eligible at all.
Five domains rest on one research centre at Kasbe Digraj. Contacting it is the highest-value action available in Phase 2, and it is a phone call.
Ginger is a horticultural crop, so enquiries at the state university go to the College of Horticulture rather than the general agronomy department. A small distinction that saves weeks.
Aurangabad appears as a ginger district in two of three source lists and a landrace called Aurangabadi exists. Local tradition here is probably older than assumed, which changes who is worth asking.
This domain expires. Everything else in the knowledge base holds for years; half of this is stale within twelve months, and the engine has to know that about itself.

central_finding.statement: Every precondition the agronomy imposes has an institutional answer available, and the whole economics turns on whether the farmer reaches it in time.

mapping.constraint: October to February storage shortfall, Domain 3

central_finding.implication: Ginger economics at Kannad with subsidy and without subsidy are entirely different propositions. Domain 13 must model both.
central_finding.constraint: Selection is by lottery, so the engine must never promise the subsidy — only the application window and the process.

shadenet_house.caveat: This is a full structure. Ginger needs about 25 percent shade for the first two months only, so a full shadenet house is probably disproportionate. Cheaper options — mulch, a tall intercrop such as tur, temporary netting — should be tested first.

trigger.english: Pre-season planning AND has_drip is false AND subsidy_lottery_result is not_applied
trigger.marathi: हंगामापूर्व नियोजन, ठिबक नाही, अनुदान अर्जही केलेला नाही

action.english: Start the drip subsidy application now. Combined central and state schemes give up to 80 percent for small and marginal farmers and 75 percent for others in this region. Apply at least six months before planting.
action.marathi: ठिबक अनुदानाचा अर्ज आत्ताच सुरू करा. केंद्र आणि राज्य योजना मिळून अल्प व अत्यल्प भूधारकांना ८०% पर्यंत आणि इतर शेतकऱ्यांना ७५% पर्यंत अनुदान मिळते. लागवडीच्या किमान सहा महिने आधी अर्ज करा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Domains 3 and 7 make drip a precondition rather than an option — the belt receives 725 to 775 mm against a crop requirement of 1320 to 1520 mm, and 55 percent of years fall below the average. The scheme covers 149 drought-prone talukas with priority to Marathwada, so the largest capital cost of the crop has an institutional answer available.
reasoning.yield_impact: Not a yield factor. It changes whether the crop is economically viable, by a factor of about five on the largest capital line.
references: govtyojanamaharashtra.com Mukhyamantri Shashwat Krushi Sinchan Yojana

rules.kannad_note: The three things the agronomy declared preconditions — drip, water storage and shade — each have a dedicated scheme, and this region is a priority area for all three. The schemes exist precisely for places like this.

review.comment_mr: Maharashtra scheme (subsidy) — कायदेशीर/नियामक क्षेत्र, agronomy scope बाहेर. Legal/regulatory desk कडून final wording आणि compliance verification झाल्यावर production release.

trigger.english: Subsidised work about to begin AND pre_sanction_received is false
trigger.marathi: अनुदानाचे काम सुरू होणार आहे पण पूर्वसंमती मिळालेली नाही
trigger.expr: pre_sanction_received IS FALSE AND subsidy_scheme_applied IS NOT NULL
trigger.expr_note: Work before pre-sanction forfeits the subsidy.

action.english: BLOCK. Work started before pre-sanction is not eligible for subsidy. Wait for the pre-sanction letter before laying drip or excavating a pond.
action.marathi: थांबा. पूर्वसंमतीपूर्वी सुरू केलेल्या कामाला अनुदान मिळत नाही. ठिबक अंथरण्यापूर्वी किंवा शेततळे खोदण्यापूर्वी पूर्वसंमतीचे पत्र येऊ द्या.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The scheme process is application, scrutiny, lottery, pre-sanction, then work. Starting early because the planting calendar is tight is the most common and most expensive error, because it forfeits the entire subsidy on work that was going to be done anyway.
reasoning.yield_impact: None on yield. It can cost the whole subsidy on the largest capital item.

rules.kannad_note: This collides directly with the tight land preparation calendar. The resolution is to start the application six months early rather than to start the work early, and the engine has to say so before March.

review.comment_mr: This is scheme/legal compliance, not agronomy. Retain the block concept, but require current Maharashtra scheme/GR/portal verification before production sign-off.

trigger.english: Subsidy discussion in progress
trigger.marathi: अनुदानाची चर्चा सुरू आहे

action.english: State clearly that selection is by lottery and never promise the subsidy. Present both the with-subsidy and without-subsidy cost cases. If not selected, the fallback is to reduce area rather than to skip drip.
action.marathi: निवड लॉटरी पद्धतीने होते हे स्पष्ट सांगा — अनुदान मिळेल असे आश्वासन कधीही देऊ नका. अनुदानासह आणि अनुदानाशिवाय अशी दोन्ही गणिते दाखवा. निवड झाली नाही तर ठिबक वगळण्याऐवजी क्षेत्र कमी करावे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Beneficiary selection is explicitly by lottery. A farmer who plans on receiving it and does not is left either without drip, which makes the crop unviable here, or with an unplanned capital cost.
reasoning.yield_impact: None directly. Prevents a plan built on an uncertain input.

rules.kannad_note: Reducing area rather than dropping drip is the right fallback, because drip is a precondition here while area is a choice. The same logic as the poor-year water planning rule.

review.comment_mr: Maharashtra scheme (subsidy) — कायदेशीर/नियामक क्षेत्र, agronomy scope बाहेर. Legal/regulatory desk कडून final wording आणि compliance verification झाल्यावर production release.

trigger.english: Water availability assessed as marginal for October to February
trigger.marathi: ऑक्टोबर ते फेब्रुवारीसाठी पाणी जेमतेम आहे

action.english: Recommend a lined farm pond, subsidised at 50 percent up to Rs 75,000. It stores the monsoon water that the drainage channels are already carrying away and supplies it back after October.
action.marathi: अस्तरीकरण केलेले शेततळे विचारात घ्या — ५०% किंवा ₹७५,००० पर्यंत अनुदान. मान्सूनमध्ये जे पाणी निचरा चरातून वाहून जाते तेच साठवून ऑक्टोबरनंतर वापरता येते.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Two problems solve each other. Monsoon water must leave the root zone to prevent soft rot, and about 27 lakh litres per acre are needed from October to February when rainfall has ended. Storage converts the disposal problem into the supply.
reasoning.yield_impact: Reduces exposure to both the waterlogging pathway and the late-season exhaustion pathway.

rules.kannad_note: Pond sizing against the 27 lakh litre shortfall has not been done and is an open item. The subsidy ceiling of Rs 75,000 may or may not cover a pond of the required size.

review.comment_mr: Maharashtra scheme (subsidy) — कायदेशीर/नियामक क्षेत्र, agronomy scope बाहेर. Legal/regulatory desk कडून final wording आणि compliance verification झाल्यावर production release.

trigger.english: Shadenet subsidy being considered for ginger
trigger.marathi: अद्रकासाठी शेडनेट अनुदानाचा विचार

action.english: Caution against it as a first step. The scheme funds a full shadenet house, whereas ginger needs about 25 percent shade for roughly the first two months. Test mulch, a tall intercrop such as tur, or temporary netting first.
action.marathi: हा पहिला पर्याय म्हणून घेऊ नका. योजना पूर्ण शेडनेट हाऊससाठी आहे, तर अद्रकाला साधारण पहिले दोन महिने सुमारे २५% सावली लागते. आधी आच्छादन, तूरसारखे उंच आंतरपीक, किंवा तात्पुरती जाळी तपासा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The crop's shade requirement is seasonal and partial, while the scheme funds a permanent full structure. Spending the capital on a disproportionate solution crowds out cheaper measures that address the same May heat problem.
reasoning.yield_impact: Prevents misallocated capital rather than adding yield.

rules.kannad_note: Worth revisiting if the dry ginger route is chosen, because excess sunlight reduces aroma and aroma is the main quality determinant for dry ginger. The quality argument could justify what the heat argument alone does not.

review.comment_mr: Maharashtra scheme (subsidy) — कायदेशीर/नियामक क्षेत्र, agronomy scope बाहेर. Legal/regulatory desk कडून final wording आणि compliance verification झाल्यावर production release.

trigger.english: Subsidy application about to be filed AND subsidy_documents_ready is false
trigger.marathi: अनुदान अर्ज करायचा आहे पण कागदपत्रे तयार नाहीत

action.english: Assemble the documents first: Aadhaar, 7/12 extract, 8-A extract, passport photograph, Aadhaar-linked bank passbook, and caste certificate where applicable. Apply on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in.
action.marathi: आधी कागदपत्रे जमवा — आधार कार्ड, ७/१२ उतारा, ८-अ उतारा, पासपोर्ट फोटो, आधार-लिंक बँक पासबुक, आणि लागू असल्यास जात प्रमाणपत्र. अर्ज mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in वर.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The application cannot proceed without the full document set, and assembling 7/12 and 8-A extracts takes time at the talathi office. Starting the assembly late compresses an already long chain.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Protects the application timeline.

rules.kannad_note: The Aadhaar-linked bank account matters specifically because payment is by RTGS to that account. A mismatch there stalls the payment after all the work is done.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: Multiple subsidy needs identified
trigger.marathi: एकापेक्षा जास्त अनुदानाची गरज आहे

action.english: Apply for drip and farm pond together in one MahaDBT application. The portal allows multiple schemes in a single application.
action.marathi: ठिबक आणि शेततळे यांचा अर्ज एकाच वेळी करा. MahaDBT वर एकाच अर्जात अनेक योजनांसाठी अर्ज करता येतो.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Both are needed at Kannad and both have the same document set and the same process. A single application halves the administrative work and keeps the two on the same timeline.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Reduces friction in the highest-value institutional action.

rules.kannad_note: Keeping the two on one timeline also means one lottery outcome rather than two, which simplifies the fallback planning considerably.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: Subsidised work complete AND geo_tagging_done is false
trigger.marathi: अनुदानाचे काम पूर्ण झाले पण जिओ टॅगिंग झालेले नाही

action.english: Arrange geo-tagging verification. Payment is released by RTGS only after it, so an unverified completed installation earns nothing.
action.marathi: जिओ टॅगिंग तपासणी करून घ्या. ती झाल्यानंतरच RTGS ने अनुदान खात्यात जमा होते — तपासणीशिवाय पूर्ण झालेल्या कामाचे पैसे मिळत नाहीत.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Geo-tagging is step seven of eight in the process. Skipping or delaying it leaves the farmer having spent the capital and completed the work with no reimbursement.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Completes the subsidy chain.

rules.kannad_note: Easy to lose track of because the work feels finished when the drip is laid. The chain has one more step and it is the one that pays.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: Farmer belongs to a priority category
trigger.marathi: शेतकरी प्राधान्य गटात मोडतो

action.english: Note the priority order and ensure the supporting document is attached. Order is families of martyred soldiers, families of farmers who died by suicide, below poverty line, widowed or deserted women, small and marginal farmers, then others.
action.marathi: प्राधान्यक्रम लक्षात घ्या आणि त्याचे कागदपत्र जोडा. क्रम — शहीद जवानांचे कुटुंब, आत्महत्याग्रस्त शेतकरी कुटुंब, दारिद्र्य रेषेखालील, विधवा किंवा परित्यक्ता महिला, अल्प व अत्यल्प भूधारक, मग इतर.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Priority affects both selection likelihood in the lottery and the applicable subsidy percentage. Small and marginal status alone is worth about 5 percentage points on the drip subsidy.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Affects the capital cost outcome.

rules.kannad_note: The engine should record the category but must handle it as administrative data only. It changes the subsidy percentage and nothing else in the advisory.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: drought_prone_listed is unverified AND subsidy planning in progress
trigger.marathi: तालुका अवर्षणप्रवण यादीत आहे का हे निश्चित नाही आणि अनुदानाचे नियोजन सुरू आहे

action.english: Confirm with the Taluka Agriculture Officer whether Kannad appears on the 149 drought-prone taluka list. It is worth about 5 percentage points of subsidy and it is a single phone call.
action.marathi: कन्नड तालुका १४९ अवर्षणप्रवण तालुक्यांच्या यादीत आहे का, हे तालुका कृषी अधिकाऱ्याकडून निश्चित करा. त्यावर सुमारे ५ टक्के अनुदान अवलंबून आहे, आणि हे एका फोनवर कळेल.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Marathwada is named a priority region, but the scheme operates on a specific list of 149 talukas. Priority region status and list membership are not the same thing.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Affects the subsidy percentage on the largest capital item.

rules.kannad_note: One of the two genuinely time-sensitive actions in the register. It gates the subsidy application, and the application gates the planting calendar.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: agro_climatic_zone is unknown or unverified
trigger.marathi: कृषी-हवामान विभाग निश्चित नाही

action.english: Assume Marathwada western zone provisionally — 600 to 750 mm and mean temperature below 26 C — and mark it as inferred. Confirm with VNMKV Parbhani or the district office.
action.marathi: तात्पुरता पश्चिम विभाग गृहीत धरा — ६०० ते ७५० मिमी, सरासरी तापमान २६ अंशांखाली — पण हे अनुमान आहे. VNMKV परभणी किंवा जिल्हा कार्यालयाकडून पुष्टी घ्या.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Three zones are identified within Marathwada on climate and soil criteria. Kannad sits in the western part of the district, above 600 m, near the Ajanta range, which places it in the western zone on the available criteria. The study does not assign talukas individually.
reasoning.yield_impact: Determines which regional recommendations apply.
references: Agro-Climatic Zonation of Marathwada, IMD plus Hydrological Project Nashik

rules.kannad_note: Ginger does not appear in the zone's recommended crop list, but that list is rainfed. Ginger sits here as an irrigated high-value crop, which is exactly why the irrigation preconditions carry the weight they do.

review.comment_mr: Confidence 0.65 — architectural intent OK, पण source / local validation पूर्ण होईपर्यंत CONDITIONAL. Season 1 data नंतर confidence upgrade करावी.

trigger.english: Area planning or market assessment before planting
trigger.marathi: लागवडीपूर्वी क्षेत्र नियोजन किंवा बाजार मूल्यांकन

action.english: State that Maharashtra has only about 4,000 hectares under ginger, roughly 1.3 percent of India's area. Local supply is limited so prices can be good, but the market is thin, technical support is limited, and seed availability is uncertain.
action.marathi: महाराष्ट्रात अद्रकाखाली फक्त सुमारे ४,००० हेक्टर क्षेत्र आहे — भारताच्या क्षेत्राच्या सुमारे १.३%. स्थानिक पुरवठा कमी असल्याने भाव चांगला मिळू शकतो, पण बाजार पातळ आहे, स्थानिक तांत्रिक मदत मर्यादित आहे, आणि बेण्याची उपलब्धता अनिश्चित आहे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: A small state area produces four consequences at once — limited local supply supporting price, a thin market that moves sharply on modest arrivals, sparse extension experience, and a correspondingly small seed market.
reasoning.yield_impact: None directly. Shapes the area decision and the seed procurement timeline.
references: Directorate of Agriculture Maharashtra 2023 via AgriTimes

rules.kannad_note: The seed market consequence is the one that bites first. A 4,000 hectare crop has a seed trade to match, so ordering late means taking whatever is available rather than the variety that was chosen.

review.comment_mr: AGRO_GUARDIAN_CUSTOM (L4) threshold — architecture बरोबर आहे पण Season 1 field data / institutional (ICAR/VNMKV/IMD) source ने calibrate होणे आवश्यक. CONDITIONAL.

trigger.english: Local experience is being sought
trigger.marathi: स्थानिक अनुभवाची चौकशी

action.english: Ask older growers and seed sellers in the district. Aurangabad appears as a ginger district in two of three published lists and a landrace called Aurangabadi is separately recorded, so local tradition is probably deeper than assumed.
action.marathi: जिल्ह्यातील जुन्या शेतकऱ्यांकडे आणि बेणे विक्रेत्यांकडे चौकशी करा. तीनपैकी दोन यादींमध्ये औरंगाबाद अद्रक जिल्हा म्हणून नोंदवलेला आहे, आणि 'औरंगाबादी' नावाची स्थानिक जातही स्वतंत्रपणे नोंदवलेली आहे — म्हणजे इथली परंपरा वाटते त्यापेक्षा जुनी असावी.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Two independent signals point the same way. A place-named landrace usually indicates sustained local cultivation over a long period, and that means adapted material and accumulated practical knowledge may exist locally.
reasoning.yield_impact: Could surface a locally adapted variety and practical knowledge that no publication contains.

rules.kannad_note: This was an unexpected finding. The working assumption was that ginger is new to this district; two source lists and a landrace name suggest otherwise, which changes who is worth asking.

review.comment_mr: Confidence 0.65 — architectural intent OK, पण source / local validation पूर्ण होईपर्यंत CONDITIONAL. Season 1 data नंतर confidence upgrade करावी.

trigger.english: Five months or less to planting AND seed_supplier_identified is false
trigger.marathi: लागवडीला पाच महिने किंवा कमी उरले आणि बेण्याचा स्रोत निश्चित नाही
trigger.expr: days_to_planting BETWEEN 140 AND 160 AND seed_supplier_identified IS FALSE
trigger.expr_note: A 4,000 hectare state crop has a seed trade to match. Late ordering forfeits u=0.138.

action.english: Identify and order seed now. With only about 4,000 hectares in the state the seed market is small, and late ordering means accepting whatever is available rather than the chosen variety.
action.marathi: बेण्याचा स्रोत आत्ताच निश्चित करा आणि order द्या. राज्यात फक्त ४,००० हेक्टर क्षेत्र असल्याने बेण्याचा बाजारही लहान आहे — उशिरा मागवल्यास निवडलेली जात नव्हे, मिळेल ते बेणे घ्यावे लागते.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Variety selection carries a u-value of 0.138 between the best and weakest of the four main options, and seed is 28 to 35 percent of total cost. Both are forfeited if the variety is decided by availability rather than by choice.
reasoning.yield_impact: Protects the 0.138 variety value and the seed quality that sets the establishment ceiling.

rules.kannad_note: One of the two time-sensitive actions in the register. The Satara and Sangli belt is the likely practical source, and the research centre at Kasbe Digraj is in Sangli — so one contact may answer both the technical questions and the seed question.

review.comment_mr: लागवडीला ५ महिने किंवा कमी उरले असल्यास बेण्याचा स्रोत आत्ताच निश्चित करणे योग्य.

trigger.english: Improved variety seed is not available locally
trigger.marathi: सुधारित जातीचे बेणे स्थानिक मिळत नाही

action.english: Institutional sources exist — CPCRI at Kasaragod, Kerala for improved varieties, and ICAR-IISR at Kozhikode for Mahima, Rejatha and Varada. Allow for transport time and quarantine considerations.
action.marathi: संस्थात्मक स्रोत उपलब्ध आहेत — सुधारित जातींसाठी CPCRI, कासरगोड, केरळ; आणि महिमा, रीजाथा, वरदा यांसाठी ICAR-IISR, कोझिकोड. वाहतुकीचा वेळ आणि तपासणीचा विचार करा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The three recommended varieties all originate from ICAR-IISR Kozhikode. Going to the source is slower and more certain than hoping a local trader stocks them.
reasoning.yield_impact: Enables the variety choice rather than defaulting to whatever is available.

rules.kannad_note: Long-distance seed rhizome transport carries its own risk of damage and disease introduction. The seed treatment rules in Domain 6 apply with more force to bought-in material from another state.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: research_centre_contacted is false
trigger.marathi: संशोधन केंद्राशी संपर्क झालेला नाही

action.english: Contact the Halad Sanshodhan Yojana at Kasbe Digraj, Sangli. Five domains rest primarily on this one centre. Ask about Marathwada-specific recommendations, the CIB&RC list for ginger, economic threshold levels, a reliable seed source, and whether the published variety trial yields already used broad ridge layout.
action.marathi: हळद संशोधन योजना, कसबे डिग्रज, सांगली येथे संपर्क करा. या knowledge base मधील पाच Domain याच एका केंद्रावर आधारित आहेत. विचारायचे — मराठवाडा व काळ्या जमिनीसाठी विशिष्ट शिफारसी, अद्रकासाठी CIB&RC नोंदणीकृत रसायने, किडींच्या ETL पातळ्या, बेण्याचा विश्वसनीय स्रोत, आणि जातींचे प्रकाशित उत्पादन आकडे रुंद वरंब्यात घेतले होते का.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Domains 2, 4, 5, 6 and 8 draw primarily on this centre's published work. Turmeric and ginger are in the same family so its research applies directly, and one of the questions — the broad ridge trial question — is currently blocking the entire Domain 11 yield ceiling computation.
reasoning.yield_impact: Resolves a blocking open item that every u-value computation depends on.
references: Agrowon articles by Kadam, Mali and Mahajan

rules.kannad_note: The single highest-value Phase 2 action, and it is a phone call. Five domains and one blocking open item resolve through one conversation.

review.comment_mr: AGRO_GUARDIAN_CUSTOM (L4) threshold — architecture बरोबर आहे पण Season 1 field data / institutional (ICAR/VNMKV/IMD) source ने calibrate होणे आवश्यक. CONDITIONAL.

trigger.english: University enquiry being prepared
trigger.marathi: विद्यापीठाकडे चौकशीची तयारी

action.english: Direct the enquiry to the College of Horticulture at VNMKV Parbhani, not the general agronomy department. Ginger is a spice and horticultural crop.
action.marathi: चौकशी VNMKV परभणी येथील उद्यानविद्या महाविद्यालयाकडे करा, सामान्य कृषिविद्या विभागाकडे नाही. अद्रक हे मसाला व उद्यानविद्या पीक आहे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Crop classification determines which department holds the expertise. A ginger question sent to the agronomy department is likely to be redirected, which costs weeks in a season with a fixed planting deadline.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Saves time on a time-constrained calendar.

rules.kannad_note: A small distinction that saves weeks. The same logic applies when asking about crop coefficient and GDD data, both of which are horticulture questions.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: Local technical support or soil testing needed
trigger.marathi: स्थानिक तांत्रिक मदत किंवा माती परीक्षण हवे आहे

action.english: Contact KVK 1 at Paithan Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar — the nearest extension centre. Ask about soil testing, local ginger experience, and the Aurangabadi landrace.
action.marathi: कृषि विज्ञान केंद्र १, पैठण रोड, छत्रपती संभाजीनगर येथे संपर्क करा — हे सर्वात जवळचे विस्तार केंद्र आहे. माती परीक्षण, स्थानिक अद्रक अनुभव, आणि 'औरंगाबादी' जातीबद्दल विचारा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: KVK's mandate is exactly this — local technical guidance, soil testing, demonstrations and input advice. VNMKV women scientists have separately run a programme on organic turmeric guidance, and turmeric is the same family, so applicable local knowledge exists.
reasoning.yield_impact: Unblocks the soil test, which is a blocking item for Domains 2 and 4.

rules.kannad_note: The nearest institutional resource to the plot, and the natural first stop for the soil test that two domains are waiting on.

review.comment_mr: AGRO_GUARDIAN_CUSTOM (L4) threshold — architecture बरोबर आहे पण Season 1 field data / institutional (ICAR/VNMKV/IMD) source ने calibrate होणे आवश्यक. CONDITIONAL.

trigger.english: Soil test being arranged
trigger.marathi: माती परीक्षणाची व्यवस्था केली जात आहे

action.english: Request free lime, zinc and iron SEPARATELY. They are absent from the standard soil health card and they are precisely the parameters that drive the calcareous yellowing problem and the whole micronutrient schedule.
action.marathi: मुक्त चुनखडी, जस्त आणि लोह हे तीन घटक वेगळे मागा. नेहमीच्या मृदा आरोग्य पत्रिकेत ते नसतात — आणि तेच चुनखडीमुळे होणारा पिवळेपणा आणि संपूर्ण सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्य वेळापत्रक ठरवतात.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The routine panel covers pH, EC, organic carbon and NPK. Free lime predicts whether the yellowing problem will occur; zinc and iron are the nutrients it locks up. Without them the Domain 4 micronutrient rules run on assumption.
reasoning.yield_impact: Enables correct micronutrient dosing, worth u = 0.11.

rules.kannad_note: Requesting them separately is the whole point. A farmer who simply asks for a soil test will receive a report without the three parameters that matter most here.

review.comment_mr: AGRO_GUARDIAN_CUSTOM (L4) threshold — architecture बरोबर आहे पण Season 1 field data / institutional (ICAR/VNMKV/IMD) source ने calibrate होणे आवश्यक. CONDITIONAL.

trigger.english: Soil assessment being planned
trigger.marathi: जमिनीचे मूल्यांकन नियोजित

action.english: Run the percolation pit test alongside the laboratory test. Dig a 30 cm pit, fill and drain fully, refill and time the second drain. It costs nothing, takes a day, and for ginger it matters more than the chemical panel.
action.marathi: प्रयोगशाळेच्या चाचणीसोबत खड्डा चाचणीही करा. ३० सेंमी खड्डा खणा, पाण्याने भरून पूर्ण मुरू द्या, पुन्हा भरा आणि वेळ मोजा. खर्च शून्य, वेळ एक दिवस — आणि अद्रकासाठी ती रासायनिक अहवालापेक्षा जास्त निर्णायक आहे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: For ginger the governing soil risk is physical drainage rather than chemical fertility, and no laboratory report measures infiltration on this plot. Above 12 hours the recommendation is to avoid ginger there altogether.
reasoning.yield_impact: Determines bed height, channel design, and in the worst case the go or no-go decision.

rules.kannad_note: Zero cost, one day, no laboratory, and it can prevent a Rs 1.45 lakh loss on an unsuitable plot. It belongs in the same conversation as the soil test, not after it.

review.comment_mr: AGRO_GUARDIAN_CUSTOM (L4) threshold — architecture बरोबर आहे पण Season 1 field data / institutional (ICAR/VNMKV/IMD) source ने calibrate होणे आवश्यक. CONDITIONAL.

trigger.english: Any chemical recommendation is about to be emitted AND cibrc_list_checked_date is empty or stale
trigger.marathi: कोणतीही रासायनिक शिफारस दिली जात आहे आणि CIB&RC यादी तपासलेली नाही किंवा जुनी आहे

action.english: Apply the standing behaviour: biological and cultural options first, name the molecule and group, state the source dose as reference only, defer the actual dose to the label, and append that CIB&RC label claim for ginger must be verified. Where the pre-harvest interval is unknown, block spraying within 30 days of harvest.
action.marathi: ठरलेले वर्तन पाळा — जैविक व सांस्कृतिक पर्याय प्रथम, रसायनाचे नाव व गट सांगा, स्रोतातील मात्रा फक्त संदर्भ म्हणून द्या, प्रत्यक्ष मात्रा लेबलनुसार, आणि अद्रकासाठी CIB&RC नोंदणी तपासण्याचा शेरा जोडा. प्रतीक्षा कालावधी माहीत नसल्यास काढणीपूर्वी ३० दिवस फवारणी अडवा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Ginger is a minor crop and many chemicals recommended in state extension literature lack a ginger-specific label claim. This is the largest remaining gap in the knowledge base and it affects four domains, but it is not blocking because biological and cultural options cover the main pests and diseases.
reasoning.yield_impact: Regulatory compliance rather than yield. Protects the platform and the farmer.

rules.kannad_note: Worth restating that this gap does not stop the product working. The free and biological tier covers the main pests and diseases, and for bacterial wilt no chemical works anyway.

review.comment_mr: AGRO_GUARDIAN_CUSTOM (L4) threshold — architecture बरोबर आहे पण Season 1 field data / institutional (ICAR/VNMKV/IMD) source ने calibrate होणे आवश्यक. CONDITIONAL.

trigger.english: New borewell or well deepening being considered AND cgwb_block_category is unverified
trigger.marathi: नवीन बोअरवेल किंवा विहीर खोल करण्याचा विचार, आणि भूजल वर्गीकरण माहीत नाही

action.english: Check the CGWB block classification for Kannad before planning new extraction. If the block is over-exploited, permission may be restricted and the farm pond becomes the only expansion route.
action.marathi: नवीन उपसा नियोजित करण्यापूर्वी कन्नड ब्लॉकचे भूजल वर्गीकरण तपासा. ब्लॉक अति-शोषित असल्यास परवानगी मिळणे अवघड होते आणि शेततळे हाच एकमेव विस्तार-पर्याय उरतो.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: October to February requires about 27 lakh litres per acre entirely from stored or pumped water. If the block classification restricts new extraction, the water plan must be built around storage instead, and that changes both the capital plan and the viable area.
reasoning.yield_impact: None directly. Determines whether the water plan is achievable at all.

rules.kannad_note: This is the check that decides whether the farm pond is an option or a necessity. In an over-exploited block it stops being a nice-to-have.

review.comment_mr: Confidence 0.72 — architectural intent OK, पण source / local validation पूर्ण होईपर्यंत CONDITIONAL. Season 1 data नंतर confidence upgrade करावी.

trigger.english: Malabar sulphur fumigation method being considered
trigger.marathi: मलबार गंधक धुरी पद्धतीचा विचार

action.english: Verify the FSSAI and export SO2 residue limits for ginger before proceeding. Until they are confirmed, present simple sun drying as the route.
action.marathi: पुढे जाण्यापूर्वी अद्रकातील SO2 अवशेषांच्या FSSAI व निर्यात मर्यादा तपासा. त्या निश्चित होईपर्यंत साधी वाळवणी पद्धतच सुचवा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The method uses 6 to 10 g of sulphur per kg across three 12-hour fumigation cycles. Export markets impose strict SO2 limits and some buyers reject treated produce outright, so an unverified limit is a market access risk rather than a technical one.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Protects market access on the dry ginger route.

rules.kannad_note: The method produces the bright white product that commands a premium, so the incentive to use it is real. That makes verifying the limit a priority rather than a formality.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: Pre-season planning AND pmfby_notified_for_ginger is unverified
trigger.marathi: हंगामापूर्व नियोजन आणि अद्रक विमा अधिसूचित आहे का हे माहीत नाही

action.english: Check with the District Superintending Agriculture Officer whether ginger is a notified crop under PMFBY for this district, and if not whether the restructured weather-based horticulture insurance applies. The kharif deadline of around 31 July fits a 7 June planting.
action.marathi: जिल्हा अधीक्षक कृषी अधिकाऱ्याकडे तपासा — या जिल्ह्यासाठी अद्रक PMFBY मध्ये अधिसूचित पीक आहे का, आणि नसल्यास पुनर्रचित हवामान आधारित फळपीक विमा लागू होतो का. खरीपची साधारण ३१ जुलैची मुदत ७ जूनच्या लागवडीशी जुळते.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Investment is about Rs 1.45 lakh per acre over eight months and the main risks — water exhaustion, soft rot and price collapse — are all capable of taking most of the crop. For an exposure this size the insurance question is decisive rather than incidental.
reasoning.yield_impact: None on yield. Changes the risk profile of the whole enterprise.

rules.kannad_note: Whether ginger is notified is likely to be a no, given how small the state area is. If so, the weather-based horticulture product is the fallback worth asking about.

review.comment_mr: Confidence 0.70 — architectural intent OK, पण source / local validation पूर्ण होईपर्यंत CONDITIONAL. Season 1 data नंतर confidence upgrade करावी.

trigger.english: Crop loan being considered AND scale_of_finance_per_acre is unknown
trigger.marathi: पीक कर्जाचा विचार आणि scale of finance माहीत नाही

action.english: Obtain the scale of finance for ginger from the district lead bank. It sets the credit limit, which matters for a crop costing about Rs 1.45 lakh per acre.
action.marathi: जिल्हा अग्रणी बँकेकडून अद्रकाचा scale of finance घ्या. त्यावरून कर्जाची मर्यादा ठरते, आणि एकरी सुमारे १.४५ लाख खर्चाच्या पिकात ती महत्वाची आहे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Scale of finance is set by the district technical committee per crop. If it is set low for ginger, or not set at all because the crop is uncommon here, the credit available will not match the actual cost.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Affects whether the plan is financeable.

rules.kannad_note: Worth asking early because if the scale of finance is low the area decision changes, and the area decision has to be made before the seed is ordered.

review.comment_mr: Confidence 0.70 — architectural intent OK, पण source / local validation पूर्ण होईपर्यंत CONDITIONAL. Season 1 data नंतर confidence upgrade करावी.

trigger.english: Inputs being purchased
trigger.marathi: निविष्ठा खरेदी केल्या जात आहेत

action.english: Keep seed purchase bills and all input receipts. They are needed for loan documentation and for any insurance claim.
action.marathi: बेणे खरेदीचे बिल आणि सर्व निविष्ठांच्या पावत्या जपून ठेवा. कर्ज आणि विमा दाव्यासाठी त्या लागतात.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Claims and loan documentation require proof of expenditure. Seed is the largest single cost and the one most often bought informally, so it is the receipt most likely to be missing.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Protects the claim.

rules.kannad_note: The app can hold photographs of the bills, which is a small feature with a real payoff when a claim is made eight months later.

trigger.english: Market access being assessed before planting
trigger.marathi: लागवडीपूर्वी बाजाराची उपलब्धता तपासली जात आहे

action.english: Enquire directly with the Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar APMC and local traders whether ginger is traded and at what price. It does not appear in the state arrival lists at all.
action.marathi: छत्रपती संभाजीनगर बाजार समिती आणि स्थानिक व्यापाऱ्यांकडे थेट चौकशी करा — इथे अद्रकाची खरेदी होते का आणि भाव काय. राज्याच्या आवक यादीत हा बाजार कुठेही दिसत नाही.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Absence from the arrival lists means no reportable ginger arrival at the nearest market. The realistic outlets are Mumbai at roughly 350 km and Nagpur at roughly 500 km, so transport cost becomes a real component of net return.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Informs the area decision and the transport budget.

rules.kannad_note: If the local market genuinely does not trade ginger, the transport cost to Mumbai or Nagpur has to enter the Domain 13 model as a fixed cost rather than as an option.

trigger.english: Alternative selling channels being explored
trigger.marathi: पर्यायी विक्री मार्गांचा शोध

action.english: Check whether the local APMC is linked to eNAM, whether a farmer producer company operates in the area, and whether any processing buyer exists. In a thin market an alternative channel can be worth more than a better price at the same channel.
action.marathi: स्थानिक बाजार समिती eNAM शी जोडलेली आहे का, भागात शेतकरी उत्पादक कंपनी आहे का, आणि प्रक्रिया उद्योगाचा खरेदीदार आहे का — हे तपासा. पातळ बाजारात पर्यायी मार्ग हा त्याच बाजारातील थोड्या जास्त भावापेक्षा मौल्यवान ठरू शकतो.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: State daily arrivals are roughly one percent of onion, so the crop is exposed to a single thin channel. An alternative outlet reduces that concentration risk more effectively than optimising within the same channel.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Reduces market risk.

rules.kannad_note: A farmer producer company would also address the shared processing facility question that Domain 9 raised for the caustic soda method. Two problems, one institution.

review.comment_mr: Confidence 0.65 — architectural intent OK, पण source / local validation पूर्ण होईपर्यंत CONDITIONAL. Season 1 data नंतर confidence upgrade करावी.

trigger.english: Pre-season planning begins
trigger.marathi: हंगामापूर्व नियोजन सुरू

action.english: Issue the contact and action register in priority order, flagging the two time-sensitive items — the Taluka Agriculture Officer for the subsidy window and local seed traders for variety availability. Everything else can wait; those two cannot.
action.marathi: संपर्क व कृती यादी प्राधान्यक्रमाने द्या, आणि दोन वेळ-संवेदनशील मुद्दे ठळक करा — अनुदानाच्या मुदतीसाठी तालुका कृषी अधिकारी, आणि जातीच्या उपलब्धतेसाठी स्थानिक बेणे विक्रेते. बाकीचे थांबू शकते; ही दोन नाहीत.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Ten institutional actions are identified. Two of them gate downstream decisions with fixed deadlines — the subsidy chain takes six or more months and includes a lottery, and the seed market is small enough that late ordering forfeits the variety choice.
reasoning.yield_impact: Protects the 0.138 variety value and the capital structure of the whole enterprise.

rules.kannad_note: Sequencing the register matters as much as its contents. Ten actions presented as a flat list produces none of them; two flagged as urgent produces two.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: Any advisory draws on Domain 10 data AND the domain review_by date has passed
trigger.marathi: Domain 10 मधील माहिती वापरली जात आहे आणि तिची पुनरावलोकन तारीख उलटली आहे

action.english: Append a verification note rather than presenting the figure as current. Subsidy rates, scheme eligibility and contacts change annually by government resolution.
action.marathi: आकडा चालू म्हणून दाखवण्याऐवजी तपासणीचा शेरा जोडा. अनुदानाचे दर, योजनांची पात्रता आणि संपर्क दरवर्षी शासन निर्णयाने बदलतात.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: This is the only domain whose content expires. Agronomy in Domains 1 to 9 holds for years; roughly half of this file is stale within twelve months. The engine has to know that about itself rather than treating all stored facts as equally durable.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Prevents advice based on a lapsed scheme rate.

rules.kannad_note: This concept did not exist in the earlier domains and had to be added when Domain 10 was written. It belongs in the Core layer, because any future institutional domain for another crop will need it too.

trigger.english: A specific subsidy amount or eligibility is about to be stated to a farmer
trigger.marathi: शेतकऱ्याला अनुदानाची नेमकी रक्कम किंवा पात्रता सांगितली जात आहे

action.english: Do not state an exact amount or promise eligibility. Give the scheme name, the process and the document list, and direct the farmer to the Taluka Agriculture Officer or the current GR for the rate.
action.marathi: नेमकी रक्कम सांगू नका आणि पात्रतेचे आश्वासन देऊ नका. योजनेचे नाव, प्रक्रिया आणि कागदपत्रांची यादी द्या, आणि दराससाठी तालुका कृषी अधिकारी किंवा चालू शासन निर्णय पहायला सांगा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Sources give drip subsidy rates ranging from 60 to 80 percent, which reflects a central scheme plus a state top-up and annual GR revision. Stating any single figure as current would be wrong more often than right.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Protects credibility and prevents a financial plan built on a wrong rate.

rules.kannad_note: The spread between 60 and 80 percent on the largest capital item is large enough that a wrong figure would misstate the whole enterprise budget. Naming the scheme and the office is both safer and more useful.

review.comment_mr: अनुदानाची नेमकी रक्कम सांगण्याऐवजी योजना, प्रक्रिया, कागदपत्रे व अधिकृत GR कडे वळवणे योग्य.

trigger.english: Shared processing capacity being considered for dry ginger
trigger.marathi: सुंठ प्रक्रियेसाठी सामायिक सुविधेचा विचार

action.english: Explore the MoFPI food processing scheme as the institutional route to a shared facility. Domain 9 identified a group or cooperative facility as the safe answer for chemical processing, and this is the funding path toward one.
action.marathi: सामायिक प्रक्रिया सुविधेसाठी अन्न प्रक्रिया उद्योग मंत्रालयाच्या योजनेची चौकशी करा. रासायनिक प्रक्रिया वैयक्तिक पातळीवर सुरक्षित नाही आणि गट किंवा सहकारी केंद्र हेच उत्तर आहे — ही योजना त्याचा आर्थिक मार्ग असू शकते.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The caustic soda method produces export-grade dry ginger and is not safe at individual farm level. A shared facility resolves both the safety problem and the capital problem, and a food processing scheme is the normal route to funding one.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Opens a value-addition route that is otherwise closed on safety grounds.

rules.kannad_note: A longer-term item rather than a first-season one. It is recorded because Domain 9 closed a route on safety grounds and this is the only way that route reopens.

review.comment_mr: Confidence 0.60 — architectural intent OK, पण source / local validation पूर्ण होईपर्यंत CONDITIONAL. Season 1 data नंतर confidence upgrade करावी.

trigger.english: Comparison against state benchmarks requested
trigger.marathi: राज्याच्या सरासरीशी तुलना विचारली

action.english: Use 53 quintal per acre as the state average benchmark. Reaching 90 is roughly 70 percent above it and 110 is more than double, which is the honest way to frame what good management is worth here.
action.marathi: राज्य सरासरी ५३ क्विंटल प्रति एकर हा संदर्भ वापरा. ९० क्विंटल म्हणजे त्याहून सुमारे ७०% जास्त, आणि ११० म्हणजे दुपटीहून जास्त — चांगल्या व्यवस्थापनाचे मूल्य मांडण्याचा हा प्रामाणिक मार्ग आहे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The state average of 13.2 tonnes per hectare converts to about 53 quintal per acre. The gap between that and the genetic ceiling is attributable to management rather than to climate or soil, which is the central argument of Domain 11.
reasoning.yield_impact: Framing rather than a factor. Sets a realistic and verifiable benchmark.

rules.kannad_note: This benchmark matters for the product argument as much as for the farmer. The gap between 53 and 90 is management, and management is what the engine addresses.

trigger.english: An institutional contact has been made and information received
trigger.marathi: संस्थात्मक संपर्क झाला आणि माहिती मिळाली

action.english: Record the answer against the specific open item it resolves, with the date and the source. Several open items across Domains 1 to 9 are waiting on single institutional answers.
action.marathi: मिळालेले उत्तर ज्या मोकळ्या जागेचे निराकरण करते तिच्याविरुद्ध, तारीख आणि स्रोतासह नोंदवा. Domain १ ते ९ मधील अनेक मोकळ्या जागा एकाच संस्थात्मक उत्तरावर थांबलेल्या आहेत.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The broad ridge trial question alone unblocks the Domain 11 yield ceiling, which every u-value computation depends on. Recording answers against items rather than as loose notes is what converts a phone call into a resolved dependency.
reasoning.yield_impact: None directly. Converts institutional contact into corrected knowledge base state.

rules.kannad_note: Ten contacts producing ten conversations and no recorded answers would leave the knowledge base exactly where it is. The recording step is the one that matters.

review.comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger.english: Economic model being run for the enterprise
trigger.marathi: प्रकल्पाचे आर्थिक गणित चालवले जात आहे

action.english: Run the cost model twice — once with subsidy and once without. Ginger economics at Kannad differ fundamentally between the two, and the difference falls entirely on capital rather than on operating cost.
action.marathi: खर्चाचे गणित दोनदा चालवा — अनुदानासह आणि अनुदानाशिवाय. इथे अद्रकाचे अर्थशास्त्र या दोन परिस्थितींत मूलभूतपणे वेगळे आहे, आणि तो फरक पूर्णपणे भांडवली खर्चावर पडतो, चालू खर्चावर नाही.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Drip is a precondition, so its cost is unavoidable. Subsidy at 75 to 80 percent changes who bears it, not whether it is incurred. Since selection is by lottery, both cases are live until the result is known.
reasoning.yield_impact: None. Determines viability and the area decision.

rules.kannad_note: Domain 13 currently leaves the drip capital cost as an open figure. Until a supplier quotation exists, neither version of the model can be completed.

next_steps: 1. Call the Taluka Agriculture Officer at Kannad — drought-prone list status, current subsidy rate, application deadline. Time-sensitive and it gates the planting calendar (D10-OI-01, D10-OI-02)
2. Contact Halad Sanshodhan Yojana at Kasbe Digraj — five domains rest on it and one question there unblocks the Domain 11 yield ceiling
3. Identify and order seed now; the state seed market is small and late ordering forfeits the variety choice (D10-OI-08)
4. Build Domain 11 JSON inheriting the Domain 1 _schema block unchanged
5. Add the review_by and data-freshness concept to the Core layer, since any future institutional domain for another crop will need it
author_note: This file contains 32 rules because that is what the source document supports. Two structural findings distinguish it from the agronomy domains. First, every precondition the agronomy imposes — drip, water storage, shade — has a dedicated state scheme and Kannad sits in the priority region for all of them, which means the crop's economics with and without subsidy are entirely different propositions and Domain 13 must model both. Second, this is the only domain whose content expires: subsidy rates change by annual GR and roughly half of this file is stale within twelve months, so a review_by date and a freshness rule had to be introduced. That concept belongs in the Core layer rather than here, because any future institutional domain will need it. Selection is by lottery, so no rule promises the subsidy — only the window and the process. Status is PHASE_1_RAW_UNVALIDATED.
